• The word **"explain"** means to make something clear or easy to understand by describing it in more detail or revealing relevant facts or ideas. (समझाना)

 
 
• **Example: **Can you **explain** the process to me step by step?
 
 
 
• **"Explain" **is the correct word to use in the context of the sentence as it fits grammatically and logically. (समझाना)
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher will **explain **the concept during the next class.
 
• Here the correct tense present indefinite and subjects given in the comprehension are plural in nature, so the correct word should be **'explain'**
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate word to fill in blank no. 2 is **'explain'**.

• **Explaining **(समझाते हुए): The act of making something clear or easy to understand.

 
 
• **Example:** She** is explaining** the rules to the new players. (Pr. continuous )
 
 
 
• **Was explain **(समझाया था): Incorrect form; should be "was explaining".
 
 
• **Example: **He** was explaining** the concept when the bell rang.(pr. continuous )
